## How It Works

The solution uses high-availability by two AZ Auto Scaling Group behind an Application Load Balancer, with RDS Multi-AZ for database durability. CloudWatch alarms trigger on CPU and storage thresholds; S3 access logs provide auditing; Route 53 health checks enable DNS failover; failover verification confirms instance and DB resiliency.

## Key Points

- **HA Across AZs**: Deploy across two AZs to tolerate AZ failure.
- **Automated Scaling**: ASG maintains target CPU and handles spikes.
- **DB Durability**: RDS Multi-AZ with automated backups ensures durability and point-in-time recovery.
